bio: I'm Kaiza, and I want to make video games in the future as a way to tell the storys in my head. I have been planing this one story for a while now but I didn't want to write it out as a book. I had alredy been thinking about learning to code so that was how I decided I wanted to make it a game. I am still working on the story itself and working out the details but I do have a idea of how I want it to go.
